kits.description: Local-first StackKit for one or more nodes on private home sites

use_case_fits.title: Private AI
use_case_fits.reason: Local inference is GPU/RAM heavy and has no lite graph substitution yet.

use_case_fits.title: Developer Platform
use_case_fits.reason: Gitea+CI is not on the Basement low graph.

use_case_fits.title: File Storage and Documents
notes: Lightweight sharing. Nextcloud is not a native workload on any profile.

use_case_fits.title: Game Server
use_case_fits.reason: Post-1.0. Game servers are on-demand session load, not a low-graph resident.

use_case_fits.title: Private Mail
use_case_fits.reason: Mail is post-1.0. A mail stack is always-on active-resident (SMTP/IMAP) and does not fit low until a lite contract exists.

use_case_fits.title: Media Library
use_case_fits.reason: Jellyfin library + transcode is not on the Basement low graph. Needs a lite substitution before it can be included.

use_case_fits.title: Photos and Memories
notes: No ML search. Catalog alternative immich-lite on standalone-compose. Kit graph also substitutes stackkits-immich-lite-runtime. Mobile backup is the spike; the library otherwise waits.

use_case_fits.title: Remote Desktop
use_case_fits.reason: Guacamole is SK-M5 and not on the low graph.

use_case_fits.title: Smart Home
notes: 24/7 radio/state loop is the base load. Classic constrained-device resident. Native MCP and extra bridges stay optional.

use_case_fits.title: Password Vault
notes: Always resident for unlock/sync; almost no idle CPU. Fits the low graph.

use_case_fits.title: Private AI
use_case_fits.reason: SK-M5: Ollama/Open WebUI modules and runtime are not executable. When they are, residency is on-demand burst inference, not 24/7 training.

use_case_fits.title: Developer Platform
use_case_fits.reason: SK-M5: Gitea module is not executable. Intended load is always-on idle git host with interactive and batch CI bursts.

use_case_fits.title: File Storage and Documents
notes: Nextcloud remains planned product intent, not a selectable native alternative.

use_case_fits.title: Game Server
use_case_fits.reason: Post-1.0. Intended load is on-demand: idle none, burst interactive while a session runs.

use_case_fits.title: Private Mail
use_case_fits.reason: Post-1.0. Intended load is 24/7 inbound/outbound with interactive bursts when reading mail.

use_case_fits.title: Media Library
notes: Library waits; playback and transcode are the spike. Catalog alternative jellyfin on standard/high.

use_case_fits.title: Photos and Memories
notes: ML worker is resident base load. Ingest and interactive search are bursts on top.

use_case_fits.title: Remote Desktop
use_case_fits.reason: SK-M5: no executable module. Intended load is always-on idle gateway with interactive session bursts.

use_case_fits.title: Private AI
use_case_fits.reason: Same as standard until SK-M5 ships. High is the intended graph (GPU node + burst interactive inference).

use_case_fits.title: Developer Platform
use_case_fits.reason: Same as standard until SK-M5. CI batch bursts belong on high headroom, not on low.

use_case_fits.title: File Storage and Documents
notes: A high profile does not add collaboration or DMS. Those need their own admitted workload and lifecycle contracts.

use_case_fits.title: Game Server
use_case_fits.reason: Post-1.0. Same as standard; dedicated always-on game hosts would be a later high-graph choice.

use_case_fits.title: Private Mail
use_case_fits.reason: Post-1.0. Same functions as standard; reputation/filter extras would be high-graph substitutions.

use_case_fits.title: Media Library
notes: Same functions as standard until a high-graph media substitution exists.

use_case_fits.title: Photos and Memories
notes: Same photo functions as standard until a high-graph substitution exists. Extra headroom is kit high, not extra Immich features.

use_case_fits.title: Remote Desktop
use_case_fits.reason: Same as standard until SK-M5.

use_case_fits.title: Smart Home
notes: Same OSS functions as standard. Managed/hybrid profiles are realization, not a kit graph.

use_case_fits.title: Password Vault
notes: No extra vault functions on high until a graph substitution exists.

operations.title: Apply
operations.description: Apply the exact persisted plan after explicit local Owner approval.

operations.title: Backup
operations.description: Create a local owner-custodied backup snapshot.

operations.title: Disable backup schedule
operations.description: Revoke the local backup timer after explicit local Owner approval.

operations.title: Enable backup schedule
operations.description: Enable the CUE-governed local backup timer after explicit local Owner approval.

operations.title: Backup schedule status
operations.description: Read the local backup timer and signed schedule authorization without changing either.

operations.title: Backup status
operations.description: Read repository readiness, authenticated receipt history, current snapshot availability and declared recovery objectives.

operations.title: Drift
operations.description: Observe desired-versus-applied standalone state drift.

operations.title: Generate
operations.description: Generate rollout artifacts from the exact persisted ResolvedPlan.

operations.title: Init
operations.description: Materialize a native StackSpec from the embedded CUE authoring contract.

operations.title: Logs
operations.description: List local structured rollout logs.

operations.title: Plan
operations.description: Inspect the persisted ResolvedPlan and generated artifact closure.

operations.title: Remove
operations.description: Remove one governed workload from its exact applied ResolvedPlan after local Owner approval.

operations.title: Resolve
operations.description: Resolve StackSpec and observed Inventory into the canonical ResolvedPlan.

operations.title: Restore
operations.description: Verify and restore one signed snapshot into isolated staging.

operations.title: Abandon restore
operations.description: Close one pending or staged restore journal with explicit local Owner approval without touching repository or live volumes.

operations.title: Set up application
operations.description: Set up and verify a Plan-declared app-local owner account on the existing application.

operations.title: Status
operations.description: Read the current standalone StackKits lifecycle status.

operations.title: Upgrade
operations.description: Resolve, verify, checkpoint, install, apply, and verify a StackKits release.

operations.title: Validate
operations.description: Validate desired StackSpec intent without mutating lifecycle state.

operations.title: Verify
operations.description: Verify desired, planned, applied, and observed local state.
